sourceTitle: The Time of the End or, the World, the Visible Church, and the People of God at the Advent of the Lord
description: "The Time of the End" by Edward Hoare is a theological work written in the mid-19th century. The book discusses the state of the world, the visible Church, and the people of God as they relate to the anticipated return of Jesus Christ.
